text:
Type: speckled flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area or bedside; living room, bedroom, study
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: handwoven wool-like flatweave, green binding cord at one end
Colors: off-white cream, black flecks, small bright green accent
Shape: rectangular, flat, salt-and-pepper speckled weave, plain edges with a green cord along one end, light visual weight
Feel: natural, calm, airy, crafted
Goes with: light wood, white walls, black accents, linen; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: SJSLEV
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, and therefore unique.
